subject: rt-dy
title: RT.DY.------POL.SIGN.
description: Chart on book p. 293 (CMOA(II)-51). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; POL-SIGN (political significance) is the partner. From the subject: a second RT-DY label (RT-DY-2). From RT-DY-2: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). The line continues from the POL-SIGN dot to SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars), and from there through the APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) dot to STF (source transfer). From SOC-RT-P: EXPM (expansionism). From APP-RDEF: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
